method: Agent-inspected desktop states plus isolated Edge actions and actual rendered frozen print; not G7 or Atikha acceptance

checks.observed: Complete reports / month controls navigation; prominent Submit complete reports and Management review/close/reopen sections.
Live preview, Frozen revision, Requested/Reviewed/Returned and Open/Closed; readable reasons and setup tasks, no engine hashes in normal use.
Captured reporting setup and month history collapsed on screen; report supporting bridge disclosed separately.
Worksheet split into familiar balance/book/result columns; TB, statements, cash flows, project activity, aging and approved/actual/remaining tables.
All financial amounts are text. Admin submits fixed calculated content; Management enters reasons and decisions without financial editing or private proof fields.
Green submit/review/close/reopen buttons in task sections, clear reviewed revision picker and exact reopen-month list.
Live versus exact frozen identities, current versus stale source, immutable return/new revision and open/closed cycle; close after reopening needs a new reviewed complete revision.
Missing Return/Reopen reason is explained; closed-date Review gives the affected month and next Management task; uncertain submit/close responses retain explicit durable recovery.
